title: Cookbook:Ager Soup
steps: Scrape off the white flaky skin of the ager stalk. Pound gently for a few minutes to remove the ager pulp.

Heat a little water in a pot, and add the ager juice.

{{Recipe}}

'''Ager soup''' is a typical Nigerian draw [[Cookbook:Soup|soup]] prepared from the pulp obtained from [[Cookbook:Ager|ager]] tree. It is commonly consumed by the Tiv people.

==Ingredients==
*1 cup fresh [[Cookbook:Ager|ager]] leaves
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Palm Oil|palm oil]]
*0.4 [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]] [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]], rinsed
*1 [[Cookbook:Dryfish|smoke-dried catfish]], rinsed
*2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] [[Cookbook:Iru|nune (locust bean cake)]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Dehydrated Broth|Maggi cube]]
*3 fresh [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell peppers]], [[Cookbook:Puréeing|blended]]
*5 medium [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], blended
*1 [[Cookbook: Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] or to taste

==Procedure==
# Scrape off the white flaky skin of the ager stalk. Pound gently for a few minutes to remove the ager pulp.
# Squeeze the pulp in a small amount of water to extract the slippery juice. [[Cookbook: Sieve|Sieve]] this product to separate the juice from the fibres.
# Heat a little water in a pot, and add the ager juice.
#Add the palm oil, blended pepper, blended tomato, beef, and fish. Cook for few minutes, stirring continuously until an elastic consistency is achieved.
#Add nune, maggi cubes, and salt to taste.
#Serve with [[Cookbook:Swallow|swallows]] as desired.
